chunks: From him, from Jaʿfar ibn Muthannā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān al-Ruwāsī, from Samāʿah ibn Mihrān, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: When the sun declines, then perform eight rakʿahs, then perform the obligatory prayer as four. Then when you have finished your supererogatory prayer, whether you made it shorter or longer, perform the ʿAsr prayer.

key_terms.أَرْبَعًا: four rakʿahs, the prescribed number for the obligatory Zuhr prayer
key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةَ: the obligatory prayer, here referring to Zuhr
key_terms.ثَمَانِيَ رَكَعَاتٍ: the eight rakʿahs of recommended prayer before the obligatory Zuhr prayer
key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun passed its zenith, marking the beginning of Zuhr time

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Zuhr begin, and when should ʿAsr be performed according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the timing of the Zuhr and ʿAsr prayers and mentions the eight rakʿahs of supererogatory prayer before the obligatory Zuhr prayer. It indicates that after completing the recommended prayer, whether done briefly or at length, one should then perform the ʿAsr prayer.
